question: Is the measured maker execution cost (adverse selection + missed fills) below 4.912 bps for volatility@30m at 200 USD on deep USD-M perpetuals?

threshold.derivation: best measured gross 8.912 bps - known maker fees 4.000 bps RT

hypotheses.H1: measured execution cost < 4.912 bps and net > 0 with bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0
hypotheses.H0: measured execution cost >= 4.912 bps, or adverse selection consumes the gross
hypotheses.prediction_evidence: EXP-003M: +2.057 bps adverse selection per tape fill, gross ceiling covers 0.356x the fee floor, 0/24 queue-by-latency points net positive

gates.G1_gross_reproduction: within +/-0.5 bps of the published gross
gates.G4_net: net bps/trade > 0 and bootstrap block CI95 lower > 0
gates.G6_drawdown: max drawdown <= 10% of simulated initial equity
gates.G7_window_dominance: no window contributes > 60% of positive net
gates.G8_fill_rate: published as context; a net that only improves by filling less is FILL_SELECTED and not promoted
gates.G9_evidence_class: MEASURED_FROM_OBSERVED_TAPE; without an L2 book the tail is swept, so the maximum verdict is CANDIDATE_FOR_PREREGISTRATION

kill_switch: measured execution cost >= 4.912 bps closes the intraday OHLCV lane for 5m/15m/30m/1h permanently
what_it_unlocks: if G1-G7 pass, the artifact feeds scripts/build_strategy_admission.py and the paper admission is decided by the existing criteria; then a 72 h PAPER run with real market data
